title: Constructible etale origin of residue homology sheaves
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative Noetherian adically complete ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] with unique maximal ideal I, and let K satisfy IsSfbStratifiedPerfect [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. For every integer q, the q-th homology sheaf of Q.obj(sfbResidueComplex X I K) is isomorphic, through comparisonUpperStar, to a constructible sheaf of modules on the small etale site of X.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectModels_residueHomology (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal ∧ ∀ J : Ideal A, J.IsMaximal → J = I)
    [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)))
    (hK : IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X I K) :
    ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))),
      IsConstructibleSheaf G ∧
        Nonempty ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))) X).obj G ≅
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (sfbResidueComplex X I K)))

proof.text: Extract the given finite stratification and each covering sieve from IsSfbStratifiedPerfect. On each arrow choose its supplied bounded finite-projective P. Strict lower and upper bounds give termwise vanishing outside the interval. Apply [lem-sfb-adic-perfect-model-complete-reduction] to obtain module finiteness of H^q(k tensor_A P). Apply [lem-sfb-adic-residue-local-homology-comparison], then the exact-functor derived homology comparison and exact constant realization, to identify the localized restriction of residue homology with this constant module. The sieve of such finite local models contains the given covering sieve, so covers.

Transport finite local models through the actual AsSmall site equivalences and the specified constant-scalar equivalence of [lem-ctf-finite-comparison-model-realization]. Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-global-constructibility], converting finite generation to finite presentation over the Noetherian quotient by [lem-sc-noetherian-finite-module-finite-presentation]. This proves the intrinsic affine-local constructibility of the model of each residue homology sheaf.

The sheaf equivalence in [sk-thm-pe-constructible-comparison] supplies an intrinsic constructible etale antecedent. The actual pullback-square isomorphism of [lem-ctf-finite-comparison-model-realization] identifies its fixed-scalar realization with the displayed comparisonUpperStar image. To verify etale IsConstructibleSheaf without any finite-coefficient-set assumption, use the global stratification from [lem-sfb-noetherian-global-constructibility]. Pull the covering finite constant models back through the site equivalence, extract an etale covering family from the covering sieve, and note that constant finitely generated modules have finitely generated geometric stalks. Locality of stalk finiteness gives finite locally constant sheaves on the strata. The same partition proves IsConstructibleSheaf. Compose the counit, the pullback square and the model-realization counit for the required isomorphism.
